The '''Republic Rim Fleet''' was a military fleet of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]]. It operated in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] and was [[Battle of Yavin 4 (Great Sith War)|deployed]] against [[Exar Kun/Legends|Exar Kun]] on [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]].<ref name="TEA" />
